title.zh: 卷二十九 列傳第十九 蔡廓
title.raw: 卷二十九 列傳第十九 蔡廓 Volume 29 Biographies 19: Cai Kuo

sentences.zh: 列傳第十九

translations.literal: Biographies 19
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 19

sentences.zh: 廓博涉群書，言行以禮，起家著作佐郎。

translations.literal: Kuo was broadly versed in many books; in word and deed he observed ritual, and he first entered service as Assistant Gentleman of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Kuo read widely and conducted himself with ritual propriety. He began his career as Assistant Gentleman of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 後為宋武帝太尉參軍、中書黃門郎，以方鯁閑素，為武帝所知。

translations.literal: Later he served as Staff Officer to the Grand Commandant under Emperor Wu of Song and as Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate at the Secretariat; for his upright integrity and plain simplicity he came to the Emperor's notice.
translations.idiomatic: He later served Liu Yu as Staff Officer on the Grand Commandant's staff and as Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate at the Secretariat. His blunt honesty and unadorned manner won the Emperor's regard.

sentences.zh: 載遷太尉從事中郎，未拜，遭母憂。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Attendant-in-Ordinary on the Grand Commandant's staff, but before he could take up the appointment he suffered the death of his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon moved to Attendant-in-Ordinary on the Grand Commandant's staff, but before he could assume the post his mother died.

sentences.zh: 性至孝，三年不櫛沐，殆不勝喪。

translations.literal: By nature he was utterly filial; for three years he did not comb his hair or bathe, and he nearly succumbed to grief.
translations.idiomatic: Filial to the core, he went three years without combing his hair or bathing and nearly wasted away in mourning.

sentences.zh: 宋台建，為侍中，建議以為「鞫獄不宜令子孫下辭，明言父祖之罪。

translations.literal: When the Song regime was established, he became Palace Attendant and submitted a proposal: "In examining criminal cases, descendants should not be made to give testimony explicitly stating the crimes of fathers and forebears.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song regime was established, he became Palace Attendant and proposed: "In criminal trials, descendants should not be forced to testify explicitly against their fathers and ancestors.

sentences.zh: 虧教傷情，莫此為大。

translations.literal: To harm instruction and wound human feeling—nothing is greater than this.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing does more harm to moral teaching or wounds the heart than that.

sentences.zh: 自今但令家人與囚相見，無乞鞫之訴，便足以明伏罪，不須責家人下辭」。

translations.literal: From now on, let family members merely meet the prisoner; without petitions for interrogation, that will suffice to show guilt, and there is no need to require family members to give testimony."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth let kin visit the accused; without formal petitions for interrogation, that should suffice to establish guilt—there is no need to compel family testimony."

sentences.zh: 朝議從之。

translations.literal: Court discussion followed his view.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 世子左衛率謝靈運輒殺人，御史中丞王准之坐不糾免官。

translations.literal: The Heir Apparent's Commander of the Left Guard, Xie Lingyun, repeatedly killed men; the Imperial Censor Xu Zhunzhi was dismissed from office for failing to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Lingyun, Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent, killed men more than once; Imperial Censor Xu Zhunzhi was removed for failing to impeach him.

sentences.zh: 武帝以廓剛直，補御史中丞。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu, seeing Kuo's stern integrity, appointed him to replace Xu as Imperial Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, noting Kuo's uncompromising integrity, made him Imperial Censor in Xu's place.

sentences.zh: 多所糾奏，百僚震肅。

translations.literal: He impeached many officials, and the hundred offices trembled before him.
translations.idiomatic: He brought many impeachments, and the bureaucracy quailed before him.

sentences.zh: 時中書令傅亮任寄隆重，學冠當時，朝廷儀典，皆取定於亮。

translations.literal: At the time the Secretariat Director Fu Liang bore heavy imperial trust; his learning surpassed all contemporaries, and court ritual and precedent were all settled by Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Director Fu Liang then carried immense imperial trust. Learned beyond his peers, he set nearly every court ritual and precedent.

sentences.zh: 亮每事諮廓然後行，亮意若有不同，廓終不為屈。

translations.literal: Liang consulted Kuo on every matter before acting; when Liang's intent differed, Kuo in the end would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Liang consulted Kuo before every decision, yet when they disagreed Kuo never bent.

sentences.zh: 遷司徒左長史，出為豫章太守。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Senior Administrator on the Minister of Works' left staff, then sent out as Grand Administrator of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Senior Administrator on the Minister of Works' left staff, then went out as Grand Administrator of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 徵為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was recalled to serve as Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 廓因北地傅隆問亮：「選事若悉以見付，不論；

translations.literal: Kuo thereupon asked Fu Liang through Fu Long of Beidi: "If the entire selection process is entrusted to me as you see fit, I have no objection;
translations.idiomatic: Kuo then asked Fu Liang through Fu Long of Beidi: "If you hand me the whole selection process without reservation, I have no objection;

sentences.zh: 不然，不能拜也。

translations.literal: otherwise I cannot accept the appointment."
translations.idiomatic: otherwise I cannot take the post."

sentences.zh: 」亮以語錄尚書徐羨之，羨之曰：「黃門郎以下悉以委蔡，吾徒不復厝懷，自此以上，故宜共參同異。

translations.literal: " Liang told this to the Recording Secretary Xu Xianzhi, who said: "From Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate down, entrust all to Cai; we need no longer worry. From that rank upward, we should still jointly review differences."
translations.idiomatic: " Liang reported this to Recording Secretary Xu Xianzhi, who said: "From Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate downward, give everything to Cai—we need not concern ourselves further. From that level up, we should still review matters together."

sentences.zh: 」廓曰：「我不能為徐幹木署紙尾。

translations.literal: " Kuo said: "I cannot be Xu Ganmu signing at the foot of the yellow paper."
translations.idiomatic: " Kuo replied: "I will not be Xu Ganmu signing at the bottom of the yellow sheet."

sentences.zh: 」遂不拜。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he refused the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He declined the post.

sentences.zh: 幹木，羨之小字也。

translations.literal: Ganmu was Xianzhi's childhood name.
translations.idiomatic: Ganmu was Xianzhi's childhood name.

sentences.zh: 選案黃紙，錄尚書與吏部尚書連名，故廓言署紙尾也。

translations.literal: Selection dossiers were on yellow paper, with the Recording Secretary and the Director of Personnel signing jointly—hence Kuo's remark about signing at the foot of the paper.
translations.idiomatic: Selection dossiers were yellow sheets countersigned by the Recording Secretary and the Director of Personnel—hence Kuo's talk of signing at the foot of the page.

sentences.zh: 羨之亦以廓正直，不欲使居權要，徙為祠部尚書。

translations.literal: Xianzhi likewise, because Kuo was upright, did not wish him to hold a key post and transferred him to Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhi too, seeing Kuo's integrity, kept him from power and moved him to Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 不可；

translations.literal: Cannot be objected to;
translations.idiomatic: Nothing there is to fault;

sentences.zh: 但殺人二昆，而以之北面，挾震主之威，據上流之重，以古推今，自免為難也。」

translations.literal: but having killed two royal brothers and yet having him face north as subject, wielding the awe of one who makes his lord tremble and holding the weight of the upper reaches—judging the present by antiquity, it will be hard to escape unscathed."
translations.idiomatic: yet you helped kill two imperial brothers and now would have him bow north as your sovereign. You wield the terror of a minister who unnerves his ruler and hold the weight of the upper Yangzi. Measured by past precedent, it will be hard to come through unharmed."

sentences.zh: 廓年位並輕，而為時流所推重，每至歲時，皆束帶詣門。

translations.literal: Though Kuo was young in years and rank, the leading men of the age esteemed him; at each year's festivals they all girded themselves and came to his gate.
translations.idiomatic: Young in years and rank though he was, the age's leading men held him in esteem; every New Year they dressed formally and came to his door.

sentences.zh: 奉兄軌如父，家事大小，皆諮而後行，公祿賞賜，一皆入軌，有所資須，悉就典者請焉。

translations.literal: He served his elder brother Gui as a father; in household affairs great and small he consulted Gui before acting. Public salary and imperial gifts all went to Gui; whatever he needed he asked the steward for.
translations.idiomatic: He treated his elder brother Gui as a father. Great and small household matters he settled only after consulting Gui. Salary and imperial gifts all went to Gui; whatever he needed he requested from the household steward.

sentences.zh: 從武帝在彭城，妻郗氏書求夏服。

translations.literal: When he followed Emperor Wu at Pengcheng, his wife Lady Xi wrote asking for summer clothes.
translations.idiomatic: While following Liu Yu at Pengcheng, his wife Lady Xi wrote asking for summer garments.

sentences.zh: 廓答書曰：「知須夏服，計給事自應相供，無容別寄。

translations.literal: Kuo replied: "Knowing you need summer clothes, I reckon the household should supply them on its own; there is no call to send them separately."
translations.idiomatic: Kuo answered: "You need summer clothes—the household ought to provide them. There is no reason to send a separate shipment."

sentences.zh: 」時軌為給事中。

translations.literal: At the time Gui was Attendant Within the Gates.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was then Attendant Within the Gates.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二年，廓卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanjia, Kuo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanjia, Kuo died.

sentences.zh: 武帝常云：「羊徽、蔡廓，可平世三公。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu often said: "Yang Hui and Cai Kuo could serve as the Three Dukes in a peaceful age."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu often said: "Yang Hui and Cai Kuo would make Three Dukes in a time of peace."

sentences.zh: 」少子興宗。

translations.literal: " His youngest son was Xingzong.
translations.idiomatic: His youngest son was Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 興宗字興宗，幼為父廓所重，謂有己風。

translations.literal: Xingzong, styled Xingzong, was as a child highly regarded by his father Kuo, who said he bore his own manner.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong—style Xingzong—was cherished by his father Kuo, who said the boy carried his own bearing.

sentences.zh: 與親故書曰：「小兒四歲，神氣似可，不入非類室，不與小人遊。

translations.literal: He wrote to kin and old friends: "The little boy is four years old; his spirit seems promising. He must not enter unsuitable households or keep company with base men."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote kin and old friends: "The boy is four; his spirit looks promising. Keep him out of unworthy houses and away from low company."

sentences.zh: 」故以興宗為之名，以興宗為之字。

translations.literal: Hence he was given the personal name Xingzong and the style Xingzong.
translations.idiomatic: So he received both the personal name and style Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 年十歲喪父，哀毀有異凡童。

translations.literal: At ten he lost his father and mourned with a grief beyond ordinary boys.
translations.idiomatic: At ten he lost his father and mourned with a grief beyond that of ordinary boys.

sentences.zh: 廓罷豫章郡還，起二宅，先成東宅以與兄軌。

translations.literal: When Kuo left the Yuzhang command and returned, he built two residences and first finished the eastern house to give to his elder brother Gui.
translations.idiomatic: When Kuo returned from Yuzhang, he built two houses and finished the eastern one first for his brother Gui.

sentences.zh: 軌罷長沙郡還，送錢五十萬以裨宅直。

translations.literal: When Gui returned from leaving the Changsha command, he sent fifty thousand in cash to help pay for the house.
translations.idiomatic: When Gui came back from Changsha, he sent fifty thousand cash toward the house price.

sentences.zh: 興宗年十一，白母曰：「一家由來豐儉必共，今日宅直不宜受也。

translations.literal: Xingzong, eleven years old, told his mother: "In this family abundance and frugality have always been shared; today the house price ought not to be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong, eleven, told his mother: "Our family has always shared wealth and want alike—the house payment should not be accepted."

sentences.zh: 」母悅而從焉。

translations.literal: " His mother was pleased and agreed.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was pleased and agreed.

sentences.zh: 軌深有愧色，謂其子淡曰：「我年六十，行事不及十歲小兒。

translations.literal: Gui was deeply ashamed and told his son Dan: "I am sixty years old, yet in conduct I fall short of a ten-year-old boy."
translations.idiomatic: Gui was deeply ashamed and told his son Dan: "I am sixty, yet a ten-year-old boy outdoes me in conduct."

sentences.zh: 」尋又喪母。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he lost his mother as well.
translations.idiomatic: He soon lost his mother too.

sentences.zh: 少好學，以業尚素立見稱，為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: From youth he loved learning; for upholding plain integrity he won praise and became Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He loved learning from youth and was praised for plain integrity, becoming Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 中書令建平王宏、侍中王僧綽並與之厚善。

translations.literal: Secretariat Director Prince Jianping Hong and Palace Attendant Wang Sengchuo were both on close terms with him.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Director Prince Jianping Hong and Palace Attendant Wang Sengchuo were both close friends.

sentences.zh: 元凶弑立，僧綽被誅，凶威方盛，親故莫敢往，興宗獨臨哭盡哀。

translations.literal: When the Crown Prince murdered his father and seized the throne, Sengchuo was executed; with the tyrant's power at its height, kin and friends dared not go near, yet Xingzong alone came to wail with full grief.
translations.idiomatic: When the Crown Prince murdered his father and seized the throne, Sengchuo was executed. With the tyrant's power at its height, kin and friends dared not approach, yet Xingzong alone came to mourn with full grief.

sentences.zh: 孝武踐阼，累遷尚書吏部郎。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu ascended the throne, Xingzong was repeatedly promoted to Director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Xingzong rose to Director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時尚書何偃疾患，上謂興宗曰：「卿詳練清濁，今以選事相付，便可開門當之，無所讓也。」

translations.literal: At the time Director He Yan was ill; the Emperor told Xingzong: "You are thoroughly versed in the worthy and the unworthy; I entrust selection affairs to you. You may open your door and take charge—there is no need to defer."
translations.idiomatic: Director He Yan was then ill. The Emperor told Xingzong: "You know the worthy from the unworthy. I entrust selections to you—take charge openly, without deferring."

sentences.zh: 後拜侍中，每正言得失，無所顧憚。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Palace Attendant; on every occasion he spoke plainly of right and wrong without regard for fear.
translations.idiomatic: He was later made Palace Attendant and spoke plainly of right and wrong without fear.

sentences.zh: 孝武新年拜陵，興宗負璽陪乘。

translations.literal: At the New Year Emperor Xiaowu paid homage at the imperial tombs; Xingzong carried the seal and rode in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: At New Year Xiaowu paid homage at the tombs; Xingzong carried the seal and rode in attendance.

sentences.zh: 及還，上欲因以射雉，興宗正色曰：「今致虔園陵，情敬兼重，從禽猶有餘日，請待他辰。

translations.literal: On the return the Emperor wished to go hawking for pheasant; Xingzong said with a stern face: "Today we have paid reverent homage at the tombs with feeling and respect both heavy; hawking can wait for another day."
translations.idiomatic: On the return the Emperor wished to go pheasant hunting. Xingzong said sternly: "We have just paid reverent homage at the tombs with full solemnity. Hawking can wait for another day."

sentences.zh: 」上大怒，遣令下車，由是失旨。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was greatly angered and ordered him out of the carriage; from this he lost favor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor flew into a rage and ordered him out of the carriage. From that he lost favor.

sentences.zh: 竟陵王誕據廣陵為逆，事平，孝武輿駕出宣陽門，敕左右文武叫稱萬歲。

translations.literal: When Prince Dan of Jingling rebelled and held Guangling, and after the affair was settled Emperor Xiaowu drove out through Xuanyang Gate, he ordered the civil and military attendants to shout "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Dan of Jingling rebelled at Guangling and the revolt was crushed, Xiaowu drove out through Xuanyang Gate and ordered civil and military attendants to shout "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 興宗時陪輦，帝顧曰：「卿獨不叫？

translations.literal: Xingzong was then riding in attendance; the Emperor looked back and said: "You alone do not shout?"
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong rode in attendance. The Emperor looked back: "You alone do not shout?"

sentences.zh: 」興宗從容正色答曰：「陛下今日政應涕泣行誅，豈得軍中皆稱萬歲。

translations.literal: " Xingzong calmly answered with a composed face: "Your Majesty today ought rather to weep as you carry out executions—how can the whole army shout 'Ten thousand years'?"
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong answered calmly and evenly: "Your Majesty ought to be weeping as you carry out executions—how can the whole army shout 'Ten thousand years'?"

sentences.zh: 」帝不悅。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 興宗奉旨慰勞廣陵，州別駕範義與興宗素善，在城內同誅。

translations.literal: Xingzong received orders to go comfort Guangling; the Assistant Administrator Fan Yi was an old friend of Xingzong's and was executed inside the city together with others.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong was ordered to comfort Guangling. Assistant Administrator Fan Yi, an old friend, was executed inside the city with others.

sentences.zh: 興宗至，躬自收殯，致喪還豫章舊墓。

translations.literal: When Xingzong arrived he personally gathered the remains for burial and sent the coffin back to the old family tomb in Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingzong arrived he personally gathered the remains and sent the coffin back to the family tomb in Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 上聞謂曰：「卿何敢故爾觸網？

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it he said: "How dare you deliberately violate the net in this way?"
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard, he said: "How dare you deliberately run afoul of the law?"

sentences.zh: 」興宗抗言答曰：「陛下自殺賊，臣自葬周旋，既犯嚴制，政當甘於斧鉞耳。

translations.literal: " Xingzong answered defiantly: "Your Majesty kills rebels; your subject buries an old friend. Having violated strict prohibition, I ought properly to accept the axe."
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong answered boldly: "Your Majesty kills rebels; I bury an old friend. I have broken the law and ought to accept the axe."

sentences.zh: 」帝有慚色。

translations.literal: " The Emperor showed a look of shame.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor looked ashamed.

sentences.zh: 又廬陵內史周朗以正言得罪，鎖付甯州，親戚故人無敢瞻送，興宗時在直，請急，詣朗別。

translations.literal: Also Zhou Lang, Interior Administrator of Luling, offended by speaking plainly, was chained and sent to Ning Province; kin and old friends dared not see him off, but Xingzong, then on palace duty, asked urgent leave and went to bid Zhou farewell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Lang, Interior Administrator of Luling, had offended by speaking plainly and was chained off to Ning Province. Kin and friends dared not see him off, but Xingzong, on palace duty, asked urgent leave and went to bid him farewell.

sentences.zh: 上知尤怒。

translations.literal: When the Emperor learned of it he was all the more angry.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor learned of it he was still angrier.

sentences.zh: 坐屬疾多日，白衣領職。

translations.literal: He was punished by being kept from office many days for illness and served in plain clothes.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished with many days' leave for illness and served in plain clothes.

sentences.zh: 後為廷尉卿，有解士先者告申坦昔與丞相義宣同謀。

translations.literal: Later he became Minister of Justice; a man named Xie Shixian reported that Shen Tan had once plotted with Chancellor Yixuan.
translations.idiomatic: He later became Minister of Justice. A man named Xie Shixian reported that Shen Tan had once plotted with Chancellor Yixuan.

sentences.zh: 時坦已死，子令孫作山陽郡，自系廷尉。

translations.literal: Tan was already dead; his son Ling Sun was Grand Administrator of Shanyang and surrendered himself to the Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was already dead; his son Ling Sun, Grand Administrator of Shanyang, surrendered himself to the Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 興宗議曰：「若坦昔為戎首，身今尚存，累經肆眚，猶應蒙宥。

translations.literal: Xingzong argued: "If Tan had once been ringleader and his person still lived, after repeated amnesties he should still receive pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong argued: "If Tan had been ringleader and still lived, repeated amnesties should still have spared him.

sentences.zh: 令孫天屬，理相為隱。

translations.literal: Ling Sun is kin by blood; by principle he would conceal his father.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Sun is blood kin; by principle he would conceal his father.

sentences.zh: 況人亡事遠，追相誣訐，斷以禮律，義不合關。

translations.literal: Moreover the man is dead and the affair remote; to pursue mutual slander and calumny—judged by ritual and law, the case should not involve him."
translations.idiomatic: Besides, the man is dead and the matter long past—to pursue mutual slander by ritual and law the case should not touch him."

sentences.zh: 」見從。

translations.literal: His view was followed.
translations.idiomatic: His view was accepted.

sentences.zh: 出為東陽太守，後為左戶尚書，轉掌吏部。

translations.literal: He went out as Grand Administrator of Dongyang, later became Director of the Left Households, then transferred to head the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Grand Administrator of Dongyang, later became Director of the Left Households, then transferred to head the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 時上方盛淫宴，虐侮群臣，自江夏王義恭以下咸加穢辱；

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor was deep in licentious feasting and humiliated the hundred ministers; from Prince Jiangxia Yigong downward all were subjected to foul abuse;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then indulged in debauched feasts and humiliated the hundred ministers; from Prince Jiangxia Yigong downward all suffered foul abuse;

sentences.zh: 唯興宗以方直見憚，不被侵媟。

translations.literal: only Xingzong, for his upright integrity, was feared and not molested.
translations.idiomatic: only Xingzong, feared for his upright integrity, was left unmolested.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射顏師伯謂儀曹郎王耽之曰：「蔡尚書常免昵戲，去人實遠。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat Yan Shibo said to the Gentleman of Protocol Wang Danzhi: "Director Cai is always spared intimate jesting—he truly keeps his distance from others."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Yan Shibo told Gentleman of Protocol Wang Danzhi: "Director Cai is always spared intimate jesting—he truly keeps his distance."

sentences.zh: 」耽之曰：「蔡豫章昔在相府，亦以方嚴不狎，武帝宴私之日，未嘗相召。

translations.literal: " Danzhi said: "Cai of Yuzhang in former days in the Chancellor's office was likewise stern and not familiar; on days when Emperor Wu feasted privately he was never summoned.
translations.idiomatic: " Danzhi said: "Cai of Yuzhang in the Chancellor's office was likewise stern and distant; on Emperor Wu's private feast days he was never summoned.

sentences.zh: 每至官賭，常在勝朋。

translations.literal: Whenever officials gambled, he was always among the winning party.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever officials gambled, he was always among the winners.

sentences.zh: 蔡尚書今日可謂能負荷矣。」

translations.literal: Director Cai today can be called one who bears the load."
translations.idiomatic: Director Cai today can be called one who bears the load."

sentences.zh: 大明末，前廢帝即位，興宗告太宰江夏王義恭應須策文。

translations.literal: At the end of the Daming era, when the Former Deposed Emperor ascended the throne, Xingzong told Grand Tutor Prince Jiangxia Yigong that an investiture document would be needed.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Daming, when the Former Deposed Emperor took the throne, Xingzong told Grand Tutor Prince Jiangxia Yigong that an investiture document would be needed.

sentences.zh: 義恭曰：「建立儲副，本為今日，復安用此？

translations.literal: Yigong said: "Establishing the heir was originally for this day—why need this again?"
translations.idiomatic: Yigong said: "We established the heir for this very day—why need this again?"

sentences.zh: 」興宗曰：「累朝故事，莫不皆然。

translations.literal: " Xingzong said: "Through successive reigns the precedent has always been so.
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong said: "Every prior reign followed the same precedent.

sentences.zh: 近永初之末，營陽王即位，亦有文策，今在尚書，可檢視也。

translations.literal: Recently at the end of Yongchu, when Prince Yingyang ascended the throne, there was likewise a written investiture—now in the Secretariat and available for inspection."
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Yongchu, when Prince Yingyang took the throne, there was a written investiture too—it is in the Secretariat and can be checked."

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: They did not follow his advice.
translations.idiomatic: They did not heed him.

sentences.zh: 時義恭錄尚書，受遺輔政，阿衡幼主，而引身避事，政歸近習。

translations.literal: At the time Yigong was Recording Secretary and received the late Emperor's testament to assist in government, balancing the young ruler, yet he withdrew and avoided affairs; government passed to close attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Yigong was Recording Secretary, entrusted by the late Emperor to assist the young ruler, yet he withdrew from affairs and power passed to close attendants.

sentences.zh: 越騎校尉戴法興、中書舍人巢尚之專制朝權，威行近遠。

translations.literal: Colonel of Fast Cavalry Dai Faxing and Secretariat Attendant Chao Shangzhi monopolized court power, and their authority reached near and far.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel of Fast Cavalry Dai Faxing and Secretariat Attendant Chao Shangzhi monopolized court power, their authority reaching far and near.

sentences.zh: 興宗職管九流，銓衡所寄，每至上朝，輒與令錄以下陳欲登賢進士之意，又箴規得失，博論朝政。

translations.literal: Xingzong's office oversaw the nine ranks and bore the weight of evaluation; at each morning audience he would with the Recording Secretary and those below state his intent to elevate the worthy and advance scholars, and also admonish on gains and losses, broadly debating court governance.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong oversaw the nine ranks and bore the weight of evaluation. At each morning audience he told the Recording Secretary and those below of his intent to elevate the worthy, admonished on policy, and debated governance at length.

sentences.zh: 義恭素性恇撓，阿順法興，恒慮失旨，每聞興宗言，輒戰懼無計。

translations.literal: Yigong was by nature timid and compliant, deferring to Faxing; he constantly feared losing favor, and whenever he heard Xingzong speak he trembled in alarm without recourse.
translations.idiomatic: Timid by nature, Yigong deferred to Faxing and constantly feared losing favor; whenever Xingzong spoke he trembled without recourse.

sentences.zh: 先是，大明世奢侈無度，多所造立，賦調煩嚴，征役過苦，至是發詔悉皆削除。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Daming era extravagance knew no bounds and many constructions were raised; taxation and corvée were severe and conscript labor excessive; now edicts were issued abolishing all of these.
translations.idiomatic: Under Daming extravagance had known no bounds, taxes and corvée had been crushing, and many constructions had been raised; now edicts abolished all of it.

sentences.zh: 由此紫極殿南北馳道之屬皆被毀壞，自孝建以來至大明末，凡諸制度，無或存者。

translations.literal: Hence the Purple Forbidden Hall's north-south carriage roads and the like were all destroyed; from Xiaojian through the end of Daming, scarcely any institution remained.
translations.idiomatic: The north-south carriage roads of the Purple Forbidden Hall and the like were torn down; from Xiaojian through Daming scarcely an institution survived.

sentences.zh: 興宗於都坐慨然謂顏師伯曰：「先帝雖非盛德，要以道始終。

translations.literal: At the chief ministers' session Xingzong said with feeling to Yan Shibo: "The late Emperor, though not of towering virtue, still held to the Way from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: At the chief ministers' session Xingzong said feelingly to Yan Shibo: "The late Emperor, though no sage, still held to the Way from first to last.

sentences.zh: 三年無改，古典所貴。

translations.literal: Three years without change—the classics hold this precious.
translations.idiomatic: Three years without change—the classics prize that.

sentences.zh: 今殯宮始撤，山陵未遠，而凡諸制度興造，不論是非，一皆刊削，雖復禪代，亦不至爾，天下有識當以此窺人。

translations.literal: Now the mourning palace has only just been cleared and the tomb mound is not far, yet every institution and construction, regardless of right or wrong, is cut away entirely; even at a change of dynasty it would not go so far—men of discernment will read character from this."
translations.idiomatic: The mourning hall has barely been cleared and the tomb is still near, yet every institution and construction, right or wrong, is cut away wholesale. Even at a dynastic change it would not go so far—men of discernment will read character from this."

sentences.zh: 」師伯不能用。

translations.literal: Shibo could not adopt his view.
translations.idiomatic: Shibo could not act on his view.

sentences.zh: 興宗每奏選事，法興、尚之等輒點定回換，僅有存者。

translations.literal: Whenever Xingzong submitted selection matters, Faxing, Shangzhi, and the rest would mark and alter them, and scarcely any remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Xingzong submitted selections, Faxing and Shangzhi marked and altered them until scarcely any remained.

sentences.zh: 興宗於朝堂謂義恭及師伯曰：「主上諒闇，不親萬機，選舉密事，多被刪改，非復公筆跡，不知是何天子意。

translations.literal: At the court hall Xingzong told Yigong and Shibo: "The ruler is in mourning and does not personally handle affairs; confidential selection matters are repeatedly altered—it is no longer in the public hand, and one does not know whose will this is."
translations.idiomatic: At court Xingzong told Yigong and Shibo: "The ruler is in mourning and does not govern; confidential selections are repeatedly altered—not in our hands, and whose will this is, none can say."

sentences.zh: 」王景文、謝莊等遷授失序，興宗又欲改為美選。

translations.literal: Wang Jingwen, Xie Zhuang, and others were promoted out of proper order; Xingzong again wished to change them to worthy selections.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingwen, Xie Zhuang, and others were promoted out of order; Xingzong again sought to set them right.

sentences.zh: 時薛安都為散騎常侍、征虜將軍，太子率殷恒為中庶子。

translations.literal: At the time Xue Andu was Regular Attendant and General Who Conquers Barbarians; Yin Heng, Commander of the Heir Apparent's Left Guard, was Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Andu was Regular Attendant and General Who Conquers Barbarians; Yin Heng, Commander of the Heir Apparent's Left Guard, was Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 興宗先選安都為左衛將軍，常侍如故；

translations.literal: Xingzong first selected Andu as General of the Left Guard, Regular Attendant as before;
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong first selected Andu as General of the Left Guard, keeping his Regular Attendant post;

sentences.zh: 殷恒為黃門，領校。

translations.literal: Yin Heng as Attendant of the Yellow Gate, also holding his colonelcy.
translations.idiomatic: and Yin Heng as Attendant of the Yellow Gate while retaining his colonelcy.

sentences.zh: 太宰嫌安都為多，欲單為左衛。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor thought Andu's appointments too many and wished to give him only Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor thought Andu held too many posts and wished to give him Left Guard alone.

sentences.zh: 興宗曰：「率、衛相去，幾何之間。

translations.literal: Xingzong said: "Commander of the Guard and General of the Guard—what distance lies between them?
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong said: "Commander of the Guard and General of the Guard—what real distance is there?

sentences.zh: 且已失征虜，非乃超越，復奪常侍，則頓為降貶。

translations.literal: Moreover he has already lost General Who Conquers Barbarians—that is no promotion—and to take Regular Attendant as well would suddenly become a demotion.
translations.idiomatic: He has already lost General Who Conquers Barbarians—that is no promotion—and stripping Regular Attendant too would be a sudden demotion.

sentences.zh: 若謂安都晚過微人，本宜裁抑，令名器不輕，宜有選序，謹依選體，非私安都。

translations.literal: If you say Andu lately surpassed common men and ought by nature to be restrained so that name and office are not lightly given, there should be an order of selection; I follow selection procedure strictly and do not favor Andu."
translations.idiomatic: If you say Andu has lately outstripped common men and ought to be restrained so titles are not lightly given, there should be an order of selection. I follow procedure strictly—I do not favor Andu."

sentences.zh: 」義恭曰：「若宮官宜加越授者，殷恒便應侍中，那得為黃門而已？

translations.literal: " Yigong said: "If palace officers ought to receive extraordinary promotion, Yin Heng should be Palace Attendant—how can he be only Attendant of the Yellow Gate?"
translations.idiomatic: " Yigong said: "If palace officers deserve extraordinary promotion, Yin Heng should be Palace Attendant—how can he be only Attendant of the Yellow Gate?"

sentences.zh: 」興宗又曰：「中庶、侍中，相去實遠。

translations.literal: " Xingzong again said: "Junior Mentor and Palace Attendant are in truth far apart.
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong added: "Junior Mentor and Palace Attendant are truly far apart.

sentences.zh: 且安都作率十年，殷恒中庶百日，今又領校，不為少也。

translations.literal: Moreover Andu has served as Commander of the Guard for ten years; Yin Heng has been Junior Mentor for a hundred days; now he also holds the colonelcy—not a small matter."
translations.idiomatic: Andu has been Commander of the Guard ten years; Yin Heng has been Junior Mentor a hundred days. With the colonelcy added, that is no small post."

sentences.zh: 」使選令史顏禕之、薛慶先等往復論執，義恭然後署案。

translations.literal: He sent Selection Clerks Yan Yizhi, Xue Qingxian, and others back and forth to argue the case; Yigong then signed the dossier.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Selection Clerks Yan Yizhi and Xue Qingxian to argue back and forth until Yigong signed the dossier.

sentences.zh: 既而中旨以安都為右衛，加給事中，由是大忤義恭及法興等。

translations.literal: Soon an imperial order made Andu General of the Right Guard and added Attendant Within the Gates; from this he greatly offended Yigong, Faxing, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an imperial order made Andu General of the Right Guard and added Attendant Within the Gates, greatly offending Yigong, Faxing, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 出興宗為吳郡太守，固辭；

translations.literal: Xingzong was sent out as Grand Administrator of Wu Command and firmly declined;
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong was sent out as Grand Administrator of Wu Command and firmly declined;

sentences.zh: 又轉南東海太守，又不拜，苦求益州。

translations.literal: he was then transferred to Grand Administrator of Southern Donghai and again refused appointment, bitterly requesting Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: he was transferred to Southern Donghai and again refused, bitterly requesting Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 義恭於是大怒，上表言興宗之失。

translations.literal: Yigong thereupon flew into a rage and submitted a memorial stating Xingzong's faults.
translations.idiomatic: Yigong flew into a rage and memorialized Xingzong's faults.

sentences.zh: 詔付外詳議，義恭因使尚書令柳元景奏興宗及尚書袁湣孫私相許與，自相選署，亂群害政，混穢大猷。

translations.literal: An edict ordered external detailed deliberation; Yigong had Secretariat Director Liu Yuanjing memorialize that Xingzong and Director Yuan Min had privately promised each other appointments, selecting each other and disordering the group, harming government and befouling great policy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered external deliberation. Yigong had Secretariat Director Liu Yuanjing accuse Xingzong and Director Yuan Min of privately promising each other appointments, selecting each other, disordering government, and befouling great policy.

sentences.zh: 於是除興宗新昌太守，郡屬交州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xingzong was removed to Grand Administrator of Xinchang, the command belonging to Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong was demoted to Grand Administrator of Xinchang in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 朝廷喧然，莫不嗟駭。

translations.literal: The court was in an uproar; none did not sigh in shock.
translations.idiomatic: The court was in uproar; all sighed in shock.

sentences.zh: 先是，興宗納何後寺尼智妃為妾，姿貌甚美。

translations.literal: Earlier Xingzong had taken the nun Zhifei of Empress He's temple as concubine; her beauty was very great.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xingzong had taken the nun Zhifei of Empress He's temple as concubine; she was very beautiful.

sentences.zh: 迎車已去，而師伯密遣人誘之，潛往載取，興宗迎人不得。

translations.literal: The welcome carriage had already departed when Shibo secretly sent men to entice her, secretly went to fetch her, and Xingzong's welcome party got no one.
translations.idiomatic: The welcome carriage had already left when Shibo secretly sent men to entice her away; Xingzong's welcome party got no one.

sentences.zh: 及興宗被徙，論者並言由師伯，師伯甚病之。

translations.literal: When Xingzong was banished, commentators all said it was because of Shibo; Shibo was deeply troubled by this.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingzong was banished, commentators blamed Shibo; Shibo was deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 法興等既不欲以徙大臣為名，師伯又欲止息物議，由此停行。

translations.literal: Faxing and the rest did not wish to be known for banishing a great minister; Shibo also wished to still public discussion—therefore the transfer was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Faxing and the rest did not wish to be known for banishing a great minister; Shibo also wished to still public talk—so the transfer was halted.

sentences.zh: 頃之，法興見殺，尚之被系，義恭、師伯並誅，復起興宗為臨海王子頊前軍長史、南郡太守，行荊州事，不行。

translations.literal: Before long Faxing was killed, Shangzhi imprisoned, Yigong and Shibo all executed; Xingzong was restored as Senior Administrator to Prince Ziye of Linhai's Forward Army and Grand Administrator of Nan Command, acting as Governor of Jing Province—he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Faxing was killed, Shangzhi imprisoned, Yigong and Shibo executed; Xingzong was restored as Senior Administrator to Prince Ziye of Linhai's Forward Army and Grand Administrator of Nan Command, acting Governor of Jing—he did not go.

sentences.zh: 時前廢帝凶暴，興宗外甥袁顗為雍州刺史，固勸興宗行，曰：「朝廷形勢，人情所見，在內大臣，朝夕難保。

translations.literal: At the time the Former Deposed Emperor was brutal; Xingzong's nephew Yuan Yan was Inspector of Yong Province and firmly urged Xingzong to go, saying: "The court's situation, as men see it—in the inner ranks great ministers can scarcely survive from morning to evening.
translations.idiomatic: The Former Deposed Emperor was brutal. Xingzong's nephew Yuan Yan, Inspector of Yong Province, firmly urged him to go: "The court's situation, as men see it—great ministers inside the palace can scarcely survive from morning to evening.

sentences.zh: 舅今出居陝西，為八州行事，顗在襄、沔，地勝兵強，去江陵咫尺，水陸通便。

translations.literal: Uncle, if you go out to dwell west of the passes as administrator of eight provinces, Yan is at Xiang and Mian with superior terrain and strong troops; Jiangling is within a foot's distance, and water and land routes are convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Uncle, if you go west of the passes to administer eight provinces, I am at Xiang and Mian with strong terrain and troops; Jiangling is a step away and routes by water and land are open.

sentences.zh: 若一朝有事，可共立桓、文之功，豈與受制凶狂，禍難不測，同年而語乎。

translations.literal: If trouble arises in a morning, together we could establish the achievement of Duke Huan and Duke Wen—how can that be spoken of in the same breath as submitting to brutal madness and meeting disaster beyond reckoning?"
translations.idiomatic: If trouble comes one morning, together we could establish the achievement of Duke Huan and Duke Wen—how can that compare with submitting to a mad tyrant and meeting disaster beyond reckoning?"

sentences.zh: 」興宗曰：「吾素門平進，與主上甚疏，未容有患。

translations.literal: " Xingzong said: "I am of a plain family raised by regular promotion and am quite distant from the ruler; I cannot easily have trouble.
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong said: "I rose by plain promotion and stand far from the ruler; I am not likely to be harmed.

sentences.zh: 宮省內外既人不自保，比者會應有變。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the palace none can preserve themselves; lately there should be change.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside the palace none can preserve themselves; change should come soon.

sentences.zh: 若內難得弭，外釁未必可量。

translations.literal: If inner trouble can be quelled, outer danger may not be reckoned.
translations.idiomatic: If inner trouble can be quelled, outer danger may still be hard to measure.

sentences.zh: 汝欲在外求全，我欲居內免禍，各行所見，不亦善乎。

translations.literal: You wish to preserve yourself outside; I wish to avoid disaster inside—each following his view—is that not good?"
translations.idiomatic: You wish to preserve yourself outside; I wish to avoid disaster inside—each following his own path—is that not well?"

sentences.zh: 」時士庶危懼，衣冠咸欲遠徙，後皆流離外難，百不一存。

translations.literal: At the time gentry and commoners were in dread; officials and scholars all wished to flee far away; afterward they were scattered in outer calamity, and not one in a hundred survived.
translations.idiomatic: Gentry and commoners were in dread; officials and scholars all wished to flee far; afterward they were scattered in outer calamity, and not one in a hundred survived.

sentences.zh: 重除吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 太尉沈慶之深慮危禍，閉門不通賓客，嘗遣左右範羨詣興宗屬事。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Shen Qingzhi deeply feared disaster, closed his gates and would not receive guests; he once sent his attendant Fan Xian to Xingzong to entrust affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Shen Qingzhi deeply feared disaster, closed his gates to guests, and once sent attendant Fan Xian to entrust affairs to Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 興宗謂羨曰：「公關門絕客，以避悠悠之請謁耳，身非有求，何為見拒？

translations.literal: Xingzong told Xian: "The Duke closes his gates and cuts off guests to avoid idle petitioners; I am not one who seeks—why refuse to see me?"
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong told Xian: "The Duke closes his gates to avoid idle petitioners. I seek nothing—why refuse to see me?"

sentences.zh: 」羨復命，慶之使要興宗。

translations.literal: " Xian reported back; Qingzhi had Xingzong summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Xian reported back; Qingzhi summoned Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 興宗因說之曰：「主上比者所行，人倫道盡，今所忌憚，唯在於公。

translations.literal: Xingzong thereupon urged him: "The ruler's recent conduct has exhausted human relations; what he now fears and dreads is you alone.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong urged him: "The ruler's recent conduct has exhausted human relations; what he now fears is you alone.

sentences.zh: 公威名素著，天下所服，今舉朝惶惶，人懷危怖，指撝之日，誰不影從？

translations.literal: Your martial name has long been established and the realm submits to it; now the whole court is in panic and men harbor dread—on the day you raise your hand, who would not follow your shadow?
translations.idiomatic: Your martial name is long established and the realm submits; the court is in panic and men harbor dread—on the day you raise your hand, who would not follow?

sentences.zh: 如其不斷，旦暮禍及。

translations.literal: If you do not decide, disaster will come morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: If you do not decide, disaster will come soon.

sentences.zh: 僕昔佐貴府，蒙眷異常，故敢盡言，願思其計。

translations.literal: Your servant once served in your noble office and received exceptional favor; therefore I dare speak fully—please consider the plan."
translations.idiomatic: I once served in your noble office and received exceptional favor; therefore I dare speak fully—please consider the plan."

sentences.zh: 」慶之曰：「僕比日前慮不復自保，但盡忠奉國，始終以之，正當委天任命耳。

translations.literal: " Qingzhi said: "Your servant lately feared I could no longer preserve myself, yet in whole-hearted loyalty serving the state I hold to it from beginning to end; I should simply entrust fate to Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: " Qingzhi said: "I lately feared I could not preserve myself, yet in whole-hearted loyalty to the state I hold to the end—I should entrust fate to Heaven."

sentences.zh: 加老罷私門，兵力頓闕，雖有其意，事亦無從。

translations.literal: Moreover I am old and retired to private life; military strength is suddenly lacking; though I have the intent, the affair has no means.
translations.idiomatic: I am old and retired; military strength is gone; though I have the intent, there is no means.

sentences.zh: 」興宗曰：「當今懷謀思奮者，非復要富貴，期功賞，各欲救死朝夕耳。

translations.literal: " Xingzong said: "Those who now harbor plans and think to rise are no longer seeking wealth and honor or expecting merit and reward—they only wish to save their lives morning and evening."
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong said: "Those who now harbor plans are no longer seeking wealth or merit—they only wish to save their lives day by day."

sentences.zh: 殿內將帥，正聽外間消息；

translations.literal: Generals within the palace halls are simply waiting for news from outside;
translations.idiomatic: Generals within the palace are simply waiting for news from outside;

sentences.zh: 若一人唱首，則俯仰可定。

translations.literal: if one man takes the lead, bowing and rising can be settled in a moment.
translations.idiomatic: if one man takes the lead, the court can be settled in a moment.

sentences.zh: 況公威風先著，統戎累朝，諸舊部曲，布在宮省，誰敢不從？

translations.literal: Moreover your martial prestige was established first and you have commanded troops through successive reigns; your old subordinates are stationed throughout the palace offices—who would dare not follow?
translations.idiomatic: Your martial prestige was established first; you have commanded troops through successive reigns; your old subordinates fill the palace offices—who would dare not follow?

sentences.zh: 僕在尚書中，自當唱率百僚，案前世故事，更簡賢明，以奉社稷。

translations.literal: Your servant in the Secretariat will himself lead the hundred officials, following precedents of former ages to select the worthy and bright to serve the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: I in the Secretariat will lead the hundred officials, following former precedents to select the worthy and bright for the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 又朝廷諸所行造，人間皆言公悉豫之，今若沈疑不決，當有先公起事者，公亦不免附惡之禍也。

translations.literal: Moreover every construction the court undertakes, common people all say the Duke fully shares in it; if you now sink in doubt and do not decide, there will be those who rise before the Duke, and the Duke too will not escape the calamity of joining evil."
translations.idiomatic: Every construction the court undertakes, people say you fully share in it. If you sink in doubt, someone will rise before you—and you too will not escape the calamity of joining evil."

sentences.zh: 且車駕屢幸貴第，酣醉彌留。

translations.literal: Moreover the imperial carriage repeatedly visits your noble residence and stays long in drunkenness.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage repeatedly visits your residence and stays long in drunkenness.

sentences.zh: 又聞斥屏左右，獨入合內。

translations.literal: I also hear he dismisses attendants and enters the inner chambers alone.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear he dismisses attendants and enters the inner chambers alone.

sentences.zh: 此萬世一時，機不可失。

translations.literal: This is a once-in-ten-thousand-generations moment; the opportunity must not be lost.
translations.idiomatic: This is a once-in-ten-thousand-generations moment; the opportunity must not be lost.

sentences.zh: 僕荷眷深重，故吐去梯之言，公宜詳其禍福。

translations.literal: Your servant bears deep favor and therefore speaks words of removing the ladder; the Duke should weigh calamity and blessing."
translations.idiomatic: I bear deep favor and therefore speak words of removing the ladder; you should weigh calamity and blessing."

sentences.zh: 」慶之曰：「此事大，非僕所能行。

translations.literal: " Qingzhi said: "This affair is great; it is not something your servant can carry out.
translations.idiomatic: " Qingzhi said: "This affair is great—not something I can carry out.

sentences.zh: 事至，政當抱忠以沒耳。

translations.literal: When the affair comes, I should properly embrace loyalty and perish."
translations.idiomatic: When it comes, I should embrace loyalty and perish."

sentences.zh: 」頓之，慶之果以見忌致禍。

translations.literal: " Before long Qingzhi indeed met disaster through being envied.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Qingzhi indeed met disaster through being envied.

sentences.zh: 時領軍將軍王玄謨大將有威名，邑裏訛言玄謨當建大事，或言已見誅。

translations.literal: At the time Colonel Commandant Wang Xuamo, a great general with a martial name, had rumors in the lanes that Xuamo would raise a great affair, or that he had already been executed.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel Commandant Wang Xuamo, a great general with a martial name, was rumored in the lanes to be raising a great affair—or already executed.

sentences.zh: 玄謨典簽包法榮家在東陽，興宗故郡人也，為玄謨所信，使至興宗間。

translations.literal: Xuamo's Chief Clerk Bao Farong was from Dongyang, Xingzong's former command, and was trusted by Xuamo; he was sent to inquire of Xingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Xuamo's Chief Clerk Bao Farong, from Dongyang and trusted by Xuamo, was sent to inquire of Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 興宗謂曰：「領軍比日殊當憂懼。

translations.literal: Xingzong told him: "The Colonel Commandant lately ought to be especially fearful and anxious."
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong told him: "The Colonel Commandant lately ought to be especially fearful and anxious."

sentences.zh: 」法榮曰；

translations.literal: " Farong said;
translations.idiomatic: " Farong said:

sentences.zh: 「頃者殆不復食，夜亦不眠，恒言收已在門，不保俄頃。

translations.literal: "Lately he can hardly eat; at night he does not sleep; he constantly says arrest is already at the gate and he cannot last long."
translations.idiomatic: "Lately he can hardly eat; at night he does not sleep; he constantly says arrest is at the gate and he cannot last long."

sentences.zh: 」興宗因法榮勸玄謨舉事。

translations.literal: " Xingzong thereupon through Farong urged Xuamo to raise an affair.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong thereupon urged Xuamo through Farong to raise an affair.

sentences.zh: 玄謨又使法榮報曰：「此亦未易可行，其當不泄君語。

translations.literal: Xuamo again sent Farong to reply: "This too is not easily feasible; he should not leak your words."
translations.idiomatic: Xuamo sent Farong to reply: "This too is not easily done; he must not leak your words."

sentences.zh: 」右衛將軍劉道隆為帝所寵信，專統禁兵，乘輿當夜幸著作佐郎江斅宅，興宗乘馬車從。

translations.literal: General of the Right Guard Liu Daolong was favored and trusted by the Emperor, exclusively commanding the forbidden troops; the imperial carriage that night visited the residence of Editorial Assistant Jiang Shuo; Xingzong followed in a carriage.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Guard Liu Daolong was favored and trusted, commanding the forbidden troops. The imperial carriage that night visited Editorial Assistant Jiang Shuo; Xingzong followed in a carriage.

sentences.zh: 道隆從車後過，興宗謂曰：「劉公，比日思一閑寫。

translations.literal: Daolong passed behind the carriage; Xingzong said to him: "Lord Liu, lately I have been thinking of a quiet talk."
translations.idiomatic: Daolong passed behind the carriage; Xingzong said: "Lord Liu, lately I have been thinking of a quiet talk."

sentences.zh: 」道隆深達此旨，掐興宗手曰：「蔡公勿言。」

translations.literal: " Daolong deeply grasped the intent, squeezed Xingzong's hand and said: "Lord Cai, say no more."
translations.idiomatic: " Daolong grasped the intent, squeezed Xingzong's hand and said: "Lord Cai, say no more."

sentences.zh: 時帝每因朝宴，棰毆群臣，自驃騎大將軍建安王休仁以下，侍中袁湣孫等咸見陵曳，唯興宗得免。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor at each court feast would beat the hundred ministers with a club; from General of Agile Cavalry Prince Jian'an Xiuren downward, Palace Attendant Yuan Min and the rest all suffered abuse and dragging—only Xingzong was spared.
translations.idiomatic: At each court feast the Emperor beat the hundred ministers with a club; from General of Agile Cavalry Prince Jian'an Xiuren downward, Palace Attendant Yuan Min and the rest all suffered abuse and dragging—only Xingzong was spared.

sentences.zh: 頃之，明帝定大事。

translations.literal: Before long Emperor Ming settled the great affair.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Emperor Ming settled the great affair.

sentences.zh: 玄謨責所親故吏郭季產、女婿韋希真等曰：「當艱難時，周旋輩無一言相扣發者。

translations.literal: Xuamo reproached his close old clerks Guo Jichan and son-in-law Wei Xizhen and the rest: "In hard times, none of you companions spoke a word to stir action."
translations.idiomatic: Xuamo reproached close clerks Guo Jichan and son-in-law Wei Xizhen: "In hard times, none of you spoke a word to stir action."

sentences.zh: 」季產曰：「蔡尚書令包法榮所道，非不會機，但大事難行耳。

translations.literal: " Jichan said: "What Attendant Director Cai had Bao Farong convey was not missing the moment, but the great affair was hard to carry out.
translations.idiomatic: " Jichan said: "What Director Cai had Bao Farong convey was not missing the moment, but the great affair was hard to carry out.

sentences.zh: 季產言亦何益。

translations.literal: Jichan's words also did no good."
translations.idiomatic: Jichan's words also did no good."

sentences.zh: 」玄謨有慚色。

translations.literal: " Xuamo showed a look of shame.
translations.idiomatic: Xuamo looked ashamed.

sentences.zh: 當明帝起事之夜，廢帝橫屍太醫合口。

translations.literal: On the night Emperor Ming raised the affair, the Deposed Emperor's corpse lay sprawled at the mouth of the Imperial Medical Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the night Emperor Ming raised the affair, the Deposed Emperor's corpse lay sprawled at the Imperial Medical Office gate.

sentences.zh: 興宗謂尚書右僕射王景文曰：「此雖凶悖，是天下之主，宜使喪禮粗足。

translations.literal: Xingzong told Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Jingwen: "Though this was brutal and rebellious, he was still lord of the realm; proper mourning should roughly suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong told Vice Director Wang Jingwen: "Though brutal and rebellious, he was still lord of the realm; proper mourning should roughly suffice.

sentences.zh: 若直如此，四海必將乘人。」

translations.literal: If it is simply like this, the four quarters will surely take advantage of men."
translations.idiomatic: If it is simply like this, the four quarters will surely take advantage."

sentences.zh: 時諸方並舉兵反，朝廷所保丹陽、淮南數郡，其間諸縣或已應賊。

translations.literal: At the time every quarter had raised troops in rebellion; the court held only several commands of Danyang and Huainan, and among their counties some had already joined the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Every quarter had raised troops; the court held only Danyang and Huainan, and some counties had already joined the rebels.

sentences.zh: 東兵已至永世，宮省危懼，上集群臣以謀成敗。

translations.literal: Eastern troops had already reached Yongshi; the palace offices were in dread; the Emperor assembled the hundred ministers to deliberate success and failure.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern troops had reached Yongshi; the palace was in dread; the Emperor assembled ministers to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 興宗曰：「宜鎮之以靜，以至信待人。

translations.literal: Xingzong said: "They should be settled by calm; utmost trust should be used toward men.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong said: "Settle them with calm; use utmost trust toward men.

sentences.zh: 比者，逆徒親戚布在宮省，若繩之以法，則土崩立至，宜明罪不相及之義。

translations.literal: Lately relatives of the rebels are stationed throughout the palace offices; if bound by law, collapse will come at once— the meaning that guilt does not extend to relatives should be made clear."
translations.idiomatic: Relatives of rebels fill the palace offices; bind them by law and collapse comes at once—the meaning that guilt does not extend to kin should be made clear."

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor followed his view.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor followed his view.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書右僕射，尋領衛尉。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also headed the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also headed the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 明帝謂興宗曰：「頃日人情言何？

translations.literal: Emperor Ming said to Xingzong: "Lately what do men say in their hearts?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming asked Xingzong: "Lately what do men say in their hearts?

sentences.zh: 事當濟不？

translations.literal: Will the affair succeed or not?"
translations.idiomatic: Will the affair succeed or not?"

sentences.zh: 」興宗曰：「今米甚豐賤，而人情更安，以此算之，清蕩可必。

translations.literal: " Xingzong said: "Now rice is very abundant and cheap, and men's hearts are more at ease; by this reckoning, pacification is certain.
translations.idiomatic: " Xingzong said: "Rice is abundant and cheap, and hearts are more at ease—by that reckoning, pacification is certain.

sentences.zh: 但臣之所憂，更在事後，猶羊公言既平之後，方當勞聖慮耳。

translations.literal: But what your servant fears is rather afterward, just as Duke Yang said that after pacification the sage's concern should begin."
translations.idiomatic: But what I fear is afterward—just as Duke Yang said that after pacification the sage's concern should begin."

sentences.zh: 」尚書褚彥回以手板築興宗，興宗言之不已。

translations.literal: Director Chu Yanhui struck Xingzong with his hand board; Xingzong spoke on without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Director Chu Yanhui struck Xingzong with his hand board; Xingzong spoke on without stopping.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「如卿言。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "As you say."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "As you say."

sentences.zh: 赭圻平，函送袁顗首，敕從登南掖門樓以觀之。

translations.literal: When Zheqi was pacified, Yuan Yan's head was sent in a box; an edict ordered Xingzong to ascend the South Yeb Gate tower to view it.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheqi was pacified, Yuan Yan's head arrived in a box; an edict ordered Xingzong to ascend the South Yeb Gate tower to view it.

sentences.zh: 興宗潸然流涕，上不悅。

translations.literal: Xingzong shed tears; the Emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong shed tears; the Emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 事平，封興宗始昌縣伯，固讓，不許，改封樂安縣伯，國秩吏力，終以不受。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Xingzong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shichang; he firmly declined and was not permitted; it was changed to Marquis of Le'an; state salary and clerical labor he ultimately did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Xingzong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shichang; he declined and was refused; it was changed to Marquis of Le'an; state salary and clerical labor he ultimately did not accept.

sentences.zh: 時殷琰據壽陽為逆，遣輔國將軍劉勉攻圍之。

translations.literal: At the time Yin Yan held Shouyang in rebellion; General Who Supports the State Liu Mian was sent to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Yan held Shouyang in rebellion; General Who Supports the State Liu Mian was sent to besiege it.

sentences.zh: 四方既平，琰嬰城固守。

translations.literal: When the four quarters were already pacified, Yan held the city and firmly defended.
translations.idiomatic: When the four quarters were pacified, Yan held the city and firmly defended.

sentences.zh: 上使中書為詔譬琰，興宗曰：「天下既定，是琰思順之日，陛下宜賜手詔數行。

translations.literal: The Emperor had the Secretariat draft an edict to persuade Yan; Xingzong said: "The realm is already settled; this is the day Yan thinks to submit. Your Majesty should bestow a handwritten edict of several lines.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat drafted an edict to persuade Yan; Xingzong said: "The realm is settled; this is the day Yan would submit. Your Majesty should bestow a handwritten edition of several lines.

sentences.zh: 今直使中書為詔，彼必疑非真。

translations.literal: Now to have the Secretariat alone draft an edict, he will surely suspect it is not genuine."
translations.idiomatic: To have the Secretariat alone draft it, he will suspect it is not genuine."

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: They did not follow his advice.
translations.idiomatic: They did not heed him.

sentences.zh: 琰得詔，謂劉勉詐造，果不敢降，久乃歸順。

translations.literal: Yan received the edict, said Liu Mian had forged it, and indeed did not dare surrender; only after long delay did he submit.
translations.idiomatic: Yan received the edict, said Liu Mian had forged it, and did not dare surrender; only after long delay did he submit.

sentences.zh: 先是，徐州刺史薛安都據彭城反，後遣使歸款，泰始二年冬，遣鎮軍將軍張永率軍迎之。

translations.literal: Earlier Inspector of Xuzhou Xue Andu had held Pengcheng in rebellion; afterward he sent envoys to submit; in winter of the second year of Taishi, General Who Stabilizes the Army Zhang Yong was sent with troops to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Inspector of Xuzhou Xue Andu had rebelled at Pengcheng; later he sent envoys to submit. In winter of Taishi year 2, General Who Stabilizes the Army Zhang Yong was sent with troops to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 興宗曰：「安都遣使歸順，此誠不虛，今不過須單使一人，咫尺書耳。

translations.literal: Xingzong said: "Andu sent envoys to submit—this is truly not empty; now one need only send a single envoy with a letter at arm's length.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong said: "Andu sent envoys to submit—that is truly not empty; now one need only send a single envoy with a letter at arm's length.

sentences.zh: 若以重兵迎之，勢必疑懼，或能招引北虜，為患不測。

translations.literal: If a heavy army is sent to welcome him, he will surely suspect and fear, and may summon northern barbarians—calamity beyond reckoning."
translations.idiomatic: Send a heavy army to welcome him and he will suspect and fear, and may summon northern barbarians—calamity beyond reckoning."

sentences.zh: 」時張永已行，不見信。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Yong had already set out and was not believed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong had already set out and was not believed.

sentences.zh: 安都聞大軍過淮，果引魏軍。

translations.literal: Andu, hearing the great army had crossed the Huai, indeed brought in Wei troops.
translations.idiomatic: Andu, hearing the great army had crossed the Huai, indeed brought in Wei troops.

sentences.zh: 永戰大敗，遂失淮北四州。

translations.literal: Yong was greatly defeated in battle and the four northern provinces were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Yong was greatly defeated and the four northern provinces were lost.

sentences.zh: 其先見如此。

translations.literal: His foresight was like this.
translations.idiomatic: His foresight was like this.

sentences.zh: 初，永敗問至，上在幹明殿，先召司徒建安王休仁，又召興宗。

translations.literal: When Yong's defeat report first arrived, the Emperor was at Ganming Hall; he first summoned Prince Jian'an Xiuren, Minister of Works, then summoned Xingzong.
translations.idiomatic: When Yong's defeat report arrived, the Emperor was at Ganming Hall; he first summoned Prince Jian'an Xiuren, Minister of Works, then Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 謂休仁曰：「吾慚蔡僕射。

translations.literal: He told Xiuren: "I am ashamed before Vice Director Cai."
translations.idiomatic: He told Xiuren: "I am ashamed before Vice Director Cai."

sentences.zh: 」以敗書示興宗，曰：「我愧卿。」

translations.literal: " He showed Xingzong the defeat report and said: "I am ashamed before you."
translations.idiomatic: He showed Xingzong the defeat report: "I am ashamed before you."

sentences.zh: 三年，出為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third year he went out as Inspector of Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he went out as Inspector of Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 初，吳興丘珍孫言論常侵興宗。

translations.literal: Earlier Qiu Zhensun of Wuxing often spoke in ways that encroached on Xingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Qiu Zhensun of Wuxing often spoke in ways that encroached on Xingzong.

sentences.zh: 珍孫子景先人才甚美，興宗與之周旋。

translations.literal: Zhensun's grandson Jingxian was very talented; Xingzong kept company with him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhensun's grandson Jingxian was very talented; Xingzong kept company with him.

sentences.zh: 及景先為鄱陽郡，會晉安王子勳為逆，轉在竟陵，為吳喜所殺。

translations.literal: When Jingxian was Grand Administrator of Poyang, Prince Jin'an Ziluan rebelled; he transferred to Jingling and was killed by Wu Xi.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingxian was Grand Administrator of Poyang, Prince Jin'an Ziluan rebelled; he transferred to Jingling and was killed by Wu Xi.

sentences.zh: 母老女幼，流離夏口。

translations.literal: His mother was old, his daughter young; they were scattered at Xiakou.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was old, his daughter young; they were scattered at Xiakou.

sentences.zh: 興宗至郢州，親自臨哭，致其喪柩，家累皆得東還。

translations.literal: When Xingzong reached Ying Province he personally came to mourn, sent the coffin back, and the whole household was able to return east.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingzong reached Ying Province he personally came to mourn, sent the coffin back, and the whole household returned east.

sentences.zh: 遷會稽太守，領兵置佐，加都督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grand Administrator of Kuaiji, with troops and staff appointed, and added as Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Grand Administrator of Kuaiji, with troops and staff appointed, and added as Commander.

sentences.zh: 會稽多諸豪右，不遵王憲，幸臣近習，參半宮省。

translations.literal: Kuaiji had many powerful clans who did not obey royal statutes; favored ministers and close attendants, half of them were in the palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: Kuaiji had many powerful clans who did not obey royal statutes; favored ministers and close attendants, half of them held palace posts.

sentences.zh: 封略山湖，妨人害政，興宗皆以法繩之。

translations.literal: They sealed off mountains and lakes, harming men and government; Xingzong bound them all by law.
translations.idiomatic: They sealed off mountains and lakes, harming people and government; Xingzong bound them all by law.

sentences.zh: 又以王公妃主多立邸舍，子息滋長，督責無窮，啟罷省之，並陳原諸逋負，解遣雜役，並見從。

translations.literal: Also princes, consorts, and princesses mostly established lodges; as sons and descendants grew, supervision and exaction knew no end; he memorialized to abolish and reduce them, and also petitioned to remit old arrears and release miscellaneous corvée—all were followed.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, consorts, and princesses mostly established lodges; as descendants grew, exaction knew no end. He memorialized to abolish them, remit old arrears, and release miscellaneous corvée—all were followed.

sentences.zh: 三吳舊有鄉射禮，元嘉中，羊玄保為吳郡行之，久不復修。

translations.literal: The Three Wu region formerly had the district archery rite; in the Yuanjia era Yang Xuanbao as Grand Administrator of Wu Command performed it; for long it was not restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Wu region formerly had the district archery rite; in Yuanjia Yang Xuanbao as Grand Administrator of Wu Command performed it; for long it was not restored.

sentences.zh: 興宗行之，禮儀甚整。

translations.literal: Xingzong performed it; the ritual was very orderly.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong performed it; the ritual was very orderly.

sentences.zh: 明帝崩，興宗與尚書令袁粲、右僕射褚彥回、中領軍劉勉、鎮軍將軍沈攸之同被顧命。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, Xingzong together with Secretariat Director Yuan Can, Vice Director Chu Yanhui, Colonel Commandant Liu Mian, and General Who Stabilizes the Army Shen Youzhi alike received the late Emperor's testament.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, Xingzong together with Secretariat Director Yuan Can, Vice Director Chu Yanhui, Colonel Commandant Liu Mian, and General Who Stabilizes the Army Shen Youzhi received the late Emperor's testament.

sentences.zh: 以興宗為征西將軍、開府儀同三司、都督、荊州刺史，加班劍二十人，被征還都。

translations.literal: Xingzong was made General Who Conquers the West, Commissioner with the Same Privileges as the Three Excellencies, Commander, and Inspector of Jing Province, with twenty ceremonial swords added; he was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong was made General Who Conquers the West, Commissioner with the Same Privileges as the Three Excellencies, Commander, and Inspector of Jing Province, with twenty ceremonial swords; he was recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 時右軍將軍王道隆任參國政，權重一時，躡履到興宗前，不敢就席，良久方去。

translations.literal: At the time General of the Right Army Wang Daolong participated in state governance with authority weighty for a time; treading his shoes he came before Xingzong and did not dare take a seat, and only after long time did he leave.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Army Wang Daolong then shared in governance with weighty authority; treading his shoes he came before Xingzong and did not dare sit, and only after long time left.

sentences.zh: 竟不呼坐。

translations.literal: He never called him to sit.
translations.idiomatic: He never called him to sit.

sentences.zh: 元嘉初，中書舍人秋當詣太子詹事王曇首，不敢坐。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanjia, Secretariat Attendant Qiu Dang visited Crown Prince Household Steward Wang Tanshou and did not dare sit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanjia, Secretariat Attendant Qiu Dang visited Crown Prince Household Steward Wang Tanshou and did not dare sit.

sentences.zh: 其後中書舍人弘興宗為文帝所愛遇，上謂曰：「卿欲作士人，得就王球坐，乃當判耳，殷、劉並雜，無所益也。

translations.literal: Afterward Secretariat Attendant Hong Xingzong was favored by Emperor Wen; the Emperor told him: "If you wish to be a gentleman, you may sit with Wang Qiu—that would be fitting; Yin and Liu mixed together would do no good.
translations.idiomatic: Later Secretariat Attendant Hong Xingzong was favored by Emperor Wen. The Emperor told him: "If you wish to be a gentleman, you may sit with Wang Qiu—that would be fitting; mixing with Yin and Liu would do no good.

sentences.zh: 若往詣球，可稱旨就席。

translations.literal: If you go to Qiu, you may say it is by imperial intent and take a seat."
translations.idiomatic: If you go to Qiu, you may say it is by imperial intent and take a seat."

sentences.zh: 」及至，球舉扇曰：「君不得爾。

translations.literal: When he arrived, Qiu raised his fan and said: "Sir, you cannot do this."
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, Qiu raised his fan and said: "Sir, you cannot do this."

sentences.zh: 」弘還，依事啟聞。

translations.literal: " Hong returned and reported according to the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Hong returned and reported.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「我便無如此何。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I can do nothing about this."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "I can do nothing about this."

sentences.zh: 」至是，興宗復爾。

translations.literal: At this time Xingzong was again like this.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Xingzong was again like this.

sentences.zh: 道隆等以興宗強正，不欲使擁兵上流，改為中書監、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，固辭不拜。

translations.literal: Daolong and the rest, because Xingzong was stern and upright, did not wish him to hold troops on the upper reaches; he was changed to Director of the Secretariat, Left Grand Master of the Palace, and Commissioner with the Same Privileges as the Three Excellencies; he firmly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Daolong and the rest, because Xingzong was stern and upright, did not wish him to hold troops on the upper reaches; he was changed to Director of the Secretariat, Left Grand Master of the Palace, and Commissioner with the Same Privileges as the Three Excellencies; he firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 興宗行己恭恪，光祿大夫北地傅隆與父廓善，興宗常修父友之敬。

translations.literal: Xingzong in conduct was respectful and reverent; Grand Master of the Palace Fu Long of Beidi was friendly with his father Kuo, and Xingzong often observed the respect due a father's friend.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong in conduct was respectful and reverent; Grand Master of the Palace Fu Long of Beidi was friendly with his father Kuo, and Xingzong often observed the respect due a father's friend.

sentences.zh: 又太原孫敬玉嘗通興宗侍兒，被禽反接，興宗命與杖，敬玉了無怍容。

translations.literal: Also Sun Jingyu of Taiyuan once had relations with Xingzong's concubine and was seized with hands bound behind; Xingzong ordered him beaten with the staff; Jingyu showed not the least shame.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jingyu of Taiyuan once had relations with Xingzong's concubine and was seized with hands bound behind; Xingzong ordered him beaten; Jingyu showed not the least shame.

sentences.zh: 興宗奇其言對，命釋縛，試以伎能，高其筆劄，因以侍兒賜之，為立室宇，位至尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Xingzong marveled at his replies; he ordered him unbound, tested his skills, admired his writing, and therefore gave him the concubine, built him a house, and he rose to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong marveled at his replies; he ordered him unbound, tested his skills, admired his writing, gave him the concubine, built him a house, and he rose to Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 其遏惡揚善若此。

translations.literal: In restraining evil and exalting good he was like this.
translations.idiomatic: In restraining evil and exalting good he was like this.

sentences.zh: 敬玉子廉，仕梁，以清能位至御史中丞。

translations.literal: Jingyu's son Lian served Liang and for pure ability rose to Imperial Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyu's son Lian served Liang and for pure ability rose to Imperial Censor.

sentences.zh: 興宗家行尤謹，奉歸宗姑，事寡嫂，養孤兄子，有聞於世。

translations.literal: Xingzong's household conduct was especially strict; he served the aunt who had returned to the clan, attended his widowed sister-in-law, and raised his orphaned elder brother's son—with renown in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong's household conduct was especially strict; he served the aunt who had returned to the clan, attended his widowed sister-in-law, and raised his orphaned elder brother's son—with renown in the world.

sentences.zh: 太子左率王錫妻范，聰明婦人也，有才學。

translations.literal: Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent Wang Xi's wife Fan was an intelligent woman with talent and learning.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent Wang Xi's wife Fan was an intelligent woman with talent and learning.

sentences.zh: 書讓錫弟僧達曰：「昔謝太傅奉寡嫂王夫人如慈母，今蔡興宗亦有恭和之稱。

translations.literal: She wrote reproaching Xi's younger brother Sengda: "Formerly Grand Tutor Xie served his widowed sister-in-law Lady Wang as a kindly mother; today Cai Xingzong likewise has the reputation of reverence and harmony."
translations.idiomatic: She wrote reproaching Xi's younger brother Sengda: "Formerly Grand Tutor Xie served his widowed sister-in-law Lady Wang as a kindly mother; today Cai Xingzong likewise has the reputation of reverence and harmony."

sentences.zh: 」其為世所重如此。

translations.literal: He was esteemed by the age like this.
translations.idiomatic: He was esteemed by the age like this.

sentences.zh: 妻劉氏早卒，一女甚幼，外甥袁覬始生子彖，而妻劉氏亦亡，興宗姊即覬母也。

translations.literal: His wife Lady Liu died early; one daughter was very young; his nephew Yuan Yan had just borne a son Tuan when his wife Lady Liu also died; Xingzong's elder sister was Yan's mother.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Liu died early; one daughter was very young; his nephew Yuan Yan had just borne a son Tuan when his wife Lady Liu also died; Xingzong's elder sister was Yan's mother.

sentences.zh: 一孫一侄，躬自撫養，年齒相比，欲為婚姻，每見興宗，輒言此意。

translations.literal: One grandson and one nephew he personally raised; their ages were comparable; he wished to arrange a marriage; whenever he saw Xingzong he would speak this intent.
translations.idiomatic: One grandson and one nephew he personally raised; their ages were comparable; he wished to arrange a marriage; whenever he saw Xingzong he spoke this intent.

sentences.zh: 大明初，詔興宗女與南平王敬猷婚。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daming an edict matched Xingzong's daughter to Prince Nanping Jingyou in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daming an edict matched Xingzong's daughter to Prince Nanping Jingyou in marriage.

sentences.zh: 興宗以姊生平之懷，屢經陳啟。

translations.literal: Xingzong, because of his sister's lifelong wish, repeatedly memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzong, because of his sister's lifelong wish, repeatedly memorialized.

sentences.zh: 帝答曰：「卿諸人欲各行己意，則國家何由得婚。

translations.literal: The Emperor answered: "If you all wish each to follow his own intent, how can the state arrange marriages?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor answered: "If you all wish each to follow his own intent, how can the state arrange marriages?

sentences.zh: 且姊言豈是不可違之處邪？

translations.literal: Moreover is your sister's word truly a place that cannot be disobeyed?"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover is your sister's word truly something that cannot be disobeyed?"

sentences.zh: 」舊意既乖，彖亦他娶。

translations.literal: The old intent was already at odds; Tuan also married elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: The old intent was already at odds; Tuan also married elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 甚後彖家好不終，顗又禍敗，彖亦淪廢當時，孤微理盡。

translations.literal: Much later Tuan's household alliance did not end well; Yan also met calamity and defeat; Tuan too was ruined and disgraced at the time—orphaned and lowly, reason exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Much later Tuan's household alliance did not end well; Yan met calamity and defeat; Tuan too was ruined and disgraced—orphaned and lowly, reason exhausted.

sentences.zh: 敬猷遇害，興宗女無子嫠居，名門高胄，多欲結姻。

translations.literal: Jingyou met with disaster; Xingzong's daughter had no son and lived as widow; eminent families and high pedigrees mostly wished to arrange marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou met with disaster; Xingzong's daughter had no son and lived as widow; eminent families and high pedigrees mostly wished to arrange marriage.

sentences.zh: 明帝亦敕適謝氏，興宗並不許，以女適彖。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming also ordered her to marry the Xie clan; Xingzong would not permit any and gave his daughter to Tuan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming also ordered her to marry the Xie clan; Xingzong would permit none and gave his daughter to Tuan.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年卒，年五十八。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiyu he died, age fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyu he died, age fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 遺命薄葬，奉還封爵。

translations.literal: His testament ordered a plain burial and return of the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: His testament ordered a plain burial and return of the enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 追贈後授，子順固辭不受，又奉表疏十餘上。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted afterward; his son Shun firmly declined and would not accept, again submitting memorials more than ten times.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were granted afterward; his son Shun firmly declined and would not accept, submitting memorials more than ten times.

sentences.zh: 詔特申其請，以旌克讓之風。

translations.literal: An edict specially granted his request to commend the spirit of self-restraint.
translations.idiomatic: An edict specially granted his request to commend the spirit of self-restraint.

sentences.zh: 初，興宗為郢州，府參軍彭城顏敬以式卜曰：「亥年當作公，官有大字者，不可受也。

translations.literal: Earlier when Xingzong was at Ying Province, Staff Officer Yan Jing of Pengcheng by divination said: "In the hai year he will become duke; of offices with the character 'great,' none may be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier when Xingzong was at Ying Province, Staff Officer Yan Jing of Pengcheng by divination said: "In the hai year he will become duke; of offices with the character 'great,' none may be accepted."

sentences.zh: 」及有開府之授，而太歲在亥，果薨于光祿大夫云。
